description: Acknowledges alerts of one watch (alert_ids, or all: true for every alert of this watch); the only call that empties the pending delivery. Returns the number acknowledged and the number remaining for the organisation; a replay changes nothing. Needs an organisation token (Authorization: Bearer hodds_...); without it the tool returns the error token_required.

all.description: true: every alert of this watch.

watch_id.description: Watch id returned by watch_need or list_watches (w_...).

name: ack_alerts

outputSchema.description: Answer of ack_alerts and POST /api/watches/{id}/ack. Replaying the same acknowledgement changes nothing.

pending.description: Delivery on the next call: alerts that wait for this organisation. Absent when there is nothing to deliver. Only ack_alerts empties it.

summary.description: One sentence in English, or in French when the request was in French.

remaining.description: Unacknowledged alerts left for the organisation.

summary.description: One sentence in English, or in French when the request was in French.

outputSchema.title: HODDS acknowledgement (0.3.0)

title: Acknowledge alerts
